name: Integrated Global Forwarding + NVOCC Staging

mandatory.description: Authenticated Render API key and exact Web/API service preflight
Live Web/API build identities match the approved digest registry
Clean dependency install, Prisma generation, API tests and Web/API production builds
NVOCC/Forwarding scope and carrier-outbound privacy controls are release-tested
Encrypted off-platform staging backup envelope is validated and retained
Fully unattended exact-image Render API rollback drill has passed
Durable release-registry baseline and hardened evidence are active

production_only.description: Real carrier/provider production credentials and contractual acceptance
Production OIDC/SSO configuration and identity-provider acceptance
Production payment/banking integration acceptance where required
Operational owner handover and formal production go-live authorization

boundary: This gate certifies free-tier staging release control and ERP transaction validation only; it does not authorize production go-live.
